title: SourceFragment — portable skill interchange structure
description: Schema for a SourceFragment, per shared/source-fragment.md. A SourceFragment is a verbatim span of organisational material: evidence, not interpretation. This is NOT a record schema — it validates a message passed between interpretation skills, carries no organisational authority, and need not be persisted. See TDR-0018. Dates are validated as JSON: normalise YAML/native date types to ISO-8601 strings before validation.

source_ref.description: Identifier of the source artefact — path, URI or document id. Opaque to this standard: its meaning belongs to whatever supplied the material.

source_hash.description: Hash of the source artefact as read, so a later reader can detect that the source has since changed.

locator.description: The exact span within the source. Shape depends on source type — page and character offsets, line range, sheet and cell range, timestamp range. Deliberately unconstrained beyond requiring a `kind`, because source types are open.

content.description: The verbatim text of the span. Not summarised, paraphrased, cleaned or normalised beyond character encoding — hedges and provisional markers are evidence.

source_time.description: When the source material was created or dated. Frequently unknown; `unknown` is an honest value and is preferred over an inferred date presented as fact.

observed_at.description: When the fragment was read. Belongs to the interpretation run, not to the organisation.

observed_by.description: Identity and version of whatever read the source.
